EN: Roster Tabs:\nThe three tabs here let you see available, assigned and lost astronauts. At the top you \nwill see the maximum roster size you can have with the current level of the facility.
Lost Kerbals: These kerbals have had an unfortunate "accident" during their career. Don't worry too much, as they will find their way home eventually.
This facility lets you manage your roster of astronauts.
The Astronaut Complex

Strategy Details: The selected strategy details and effects are shown here. For offered strategies you can use the slider to adjust the commitment you wish to make before accepting. For active strategies you have a big red button to cancel them.
Active Strategies: Here you can see the strategies that are currently active, as well as the maximum number you can accept at the current level of the facility.
Available Strategies:\nThese are the strategies that the division heads have to offer \nyou. Selecting one will show you more information.
The admin interface has three main sections to use for managing your strategies.
The Administration Building
This is your home for all things KSP-Related. You'll see it a lot as you move between different facilities, \ngetting all your kerbals organized for an epic space adventure.

Time Controls

Contract List: The three tabs here let you see available, active and completed contracts. The number you can have active is related to how advanced the Mission Control facility is.
Contract Details: The details of the selected contract and completion are shown here, along with the buttons to accept, decline and cancel (if you're not up to it).
Mission Control has a mass of information on contracts -- whether offered, active or complete. You can \npick and choose the goals for your space program and check prospective rewards.
Mission Control

Report Details: This list shows details about the reports that match your selected filter. The progress bar shows you the amount of science you have collected for that particular report compared to the amount of science that can be collected. If the bar is full then there is no point repeating that activity.
Toolbar: Across the top (from left to right) are the Technology and Science Archives tabs; the current level of Funds, Reputation and Science; and the way out.
Report Filters: Here you can filter the reports to be shown on the right. You can filter by planet, experiment, situation and biome.
The R&D Science Archives show your progress in scientific discovery. It stores all the valuable experiment \nresults that you have collected.
The Research and Development Science Archives

Technology Details: The details of the selected tree node and associated parts are shown here. You can see the prerequisite nodes to unlock it (and the button to spend Science to do this if it's locked) as well as the parts that make up the technology. At harder difficulties you will spend Funds to unlock each of the parts.
